stdout:
Upload a video. Use this tool to upload a video.

Usage:
  yutu video insert [flags]

Examples:
# Upload a public video
yutu video insert --file video.mp4 --title 'My Video' --categoryId 22 --privacy public
# Upload a private video with tags
yutu video insert --file video.mp4 --title 'Tutorial' --categoryId 27 --privacy private --tags 'go,tutorial'
# Upload an unlisted video with custom thumbnail
yutu video insert --file video.mp4 --title 'Music Video' --categoryId 10 --privacy unlisted --thumbnail cover.jpg

Flags:
  -A, --autoLevels                             Should auto-levels be applied to the upload (default true)
  -g, --categoryId string                      Category of the video
  -c, --channelId string                       Channel id of the video
  -M, --containsSyntheticMedia                 Whether the video contains altered or synthetic media
  -d, --description string                     Description of the video
  -E, --embeddable                             Whether the video is embeddable (default true)
  -f, --file string                            Path to the video file
  -K, --forKids                                Whether the video is for kids
  -h, --help                                   help for insert
  -l, --language string                        Language of the video
  -L, --license string                         youtube|creativeCommon
  -N, --notifySubscribers                      Notify the channel subscribers about the new video (default true)
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string          ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -B, --onBehalfOfContentOwnerChannel string   YouTube channel ID linked to the content owner
  -o, --output string                          json|yaml|silent
  -y, --playlistId string                      Playlist id of the video
  -p, --privacy string                         public|private|unlisted
  -P, --publicStatsViewable                    Whether the extended video statistics can be viewed by everyone
  -U, --publishAt string                       Datetime when the video is scheduled to publish
  -D, --recordingDate string                   Date and time when the video was recorded
  -S, --stabilize                              Should stabilize be applied to the upload (default true)
  -a, --tags strings                           Comma separated tags (default [yutu🐰])
  -u, --thumbnail string                       Path to the thumbnail file
  -t, --title string                           Title of the video
      --yes                                    Confirm the operation
